metadata.description: Every test target that boots the PGLite test DB materializes its schema by executing drizzle/*.sql (see packages/db-runtime/src/test-client-pglite.ts), so migrations are a real input to those runs; without them a migration edit does not invalidate the cache and the suites replay a stale pass (proven live: editing 0108's predicate left its own migration test green). Ownership narrows the input: sharedMigrations is the frozen legacy range 0000-0133 plus every NNNN_shared__*.sql (a new shared migration reruns every DB-backed suite), and ^migrations is the named input each db-schema-<domain> project defines for its own NNNN_<domain>__*.sql, so a test only rereads the migrations of the slices it depends on. db-schema-all, the schema layer, lists the whole drizzle/ folder and validates the chain once. See docs/architecture/engineering-invariants.md 2.4.
